scheme_name: National Awards For Outstanding Services In The Field Of Prevention Of Alcoholism And Substance (Drug) Abuse: Best Panchayati Raj Or Municipal Body Working For Prevention Of Alcoholism And Substance (Drug) Abuse
other_conditions: Nomination must be made by an authorized agency or person; self‑nominations are not considered.
Nominee must be recommended in writing by the authorized agency/person.
Individuals or institutions that have previously received the award are ineligible for the next three award cycles.

The eligible institution (Panchayat, Municipality, Cantonment Board or other statutory urban local body) must have worked in prevention of alcoholism and substance (drug) abuse for at least three years.

The institution must have undertaken continuous awareness programmes, adopted alcohol‑ or drug‑free policies, engaged the community, addressed stigma and discrimination, and provided or networked with treatment services.
Only nominations/recommendations emanating from authorized agencies or persons, supported by adequate justification, will be considered.
benefits_summary: Awardees receive a citation, a memento and a cash prize of ₹5,00,000.
